dashboard.name: NutsNews Backend - APM - Transaction Slow Path
dashboard.description: 24 hour dashboard for slow backend transactions, latency contributors, database span time, outbound span time, and repeated slow endpoints. Managed from ramideltoro/nutsnews-backend.

pages.name: Slow path triage
pages.description: Find the endpoints and spans most responsible for request latency.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT percentile(duration, 95) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT max(duration) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT percentile(duration, 95), max(duration), count(*) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' FACET name LIMIT 10 SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT average(duration), average(databaseDuration), average(externalDuration) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT average(duration), average(databaseDuration), average(externalDuration) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' FACET name LIMIT 10 SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT percentile(duration, 95), max(duration), count(*) FROM Span WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' AND category = 'datastore' FACET name LIMIT 10 SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT percentile(duration, 95), max(duration), count(*) FROM Span WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' AND category IN ('external', 'http') FACET name LIMIT 10 SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT filter(count(*), WHERE duration > 1), count(*) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' FACET name LIMIT 10 SINCE 24 hours ago

rawConfiguration.text: Use endpoint p95 first, then compare database and outbound span time. Prioritize repeated slow endpoints before one-off max-duration samples.
